column1: # The genome panel this study's validation ran on: every complete RefSeq Listeria
# monocytogenes assembly on 2026-10-10, with the sequence type mlst called and the clonal
# complex and lineage the Institut Pasteur scheme (listeria_2) assigns that ST. An empty cc
# is an ST the scheme places in no clonal complex, or one it does not know: those genomes go
# in neither group. type_genomes.py regenerates this (with a path column) in the work folder;
# this copy is here so a later run can be compared against the one the record describes.
